verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Re-read the Office of the Governor of Hawaii news release of 15 Jul 2026 ('Gov. Green Completes Bill Signing Season and Issues Veto Decision', governor.hawaii.gov, stored 12 Oct 2026), which says SB 3001 became Act 248 and describes its content, and the Transparency Coalition's tracker article (transparencycoalition.ai, not an official site; stored 17 Oct 2026), which gives 14 Jul 2026 as the enactment and effective date. Stored again in this run: the Governor's release of 14 Jul 2026 (governor.hawaii.gov/?p=12919), which says the Governor 'today signed' three measures, among them SB 3001: Relating to Artificial Intelligence, Act 248, and describes its disclosures, response protocols, annual reports and protections for minors. Both Governor's releases are announcements, not the Act's text, so their quotes count as alt-official. The conference draft of SB 3001 on data.capitol.hawaii.gov, which would carry the Act's text and its effective-date section, could not be stored (HTTP 403, also in the browser), as Governor's Message No. 1350 could not before. The 14 Jul 2026 effective date therefore rests only on the tracker, and the summary follows the two Governor's releases.

'In force' is kept, but the Act's effective-date section has not been read.
